title: Perianal Nerval Block in Proctological Interventions
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate whether a local perianal block performed during a proctological intervention can reduce the postoperative pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with surgical indication for hemorrhoids, fistula-in-ano or anal fissures.
* Age of 18 or above

Exclusion Criteria:

* age under 18.
* Patients unable to understand an informed consent.
* Emergency operations
* Pregnant women.
* Patients with acute perianal infection.
* Patients allergic to any component of the local anesthetic
